text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmmm... Mmhm!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I can see it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can see myself running at a speed like
never
before, charging down the
Bakushin Road!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let us Bakushin with gusto!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First off, what races shall I compete in to
ready
myself for the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's me running, so it has to be a G1! The
Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes? Or perhaps
the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have enough experience to
debut in a
G1 race yet. For now, she's
better off competing
in something like...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'd like to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm...
choice_data_list: Wanna run the 'Keio Hai Junior Stakes'?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, 1,400 meters?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I'd like to make the Satsuki Sho my
first
Classic race! Wouldn't that be way
too short by
comparison?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I feel like even 1,400 meters
might be
too long for Sakura Bakushin
O...
choice_data_list: Junior Class races are all short distances.
Junior Class races are all short distances, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Guh! But, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Humility?
choice_data_list: As the class rep, I have to show my sincerity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Jumping headfirst into G1 races might
seem cool,
but I'm worried some people
might keel over in
shock if they see her
speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to convince her it would be best to
first show
up at the Keio Hai Junior
Stakes and gradually let
everyone get
used to her speed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I think...
choice_data_list: Don't you think that's a form of kindness?
Don't you think that's a form of kindness?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then for the next race, the
goal is to
let the world at large witness
my speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In no time, the crowd will be used to
chanting
"Whoa, so fast!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One way or another, we decide our next
race will
be the Keio Hai Junior Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!
